title: Auto Fill Your Job Application with Teal | Apply to More Jobs FASTER
description:
Auto fill your job applications with Teal's new Autofill feature. 

You probably know firsthand the frustration of filling out job applications online and re-entering everything that's already in your resume—but did you know 60% of job seekers quit in the middle of the process because an application's too long or complex? 

We want to speed up that process. Starting today, you'll see the Beta test of the new Autofill feature live in the Teal Chrome extension. Just choose a Teal-created resume, pair it with a job description from your Job Tracker, and we'll do the rest (with some help from AI).
